source_paths.owner: The GPTAdmin repository is owned by megamen32.

live_route_readback.boundary: The safe route summary omits command and cwd. Its exact command is documented in docs/AGENT_DELIVER_API.md, but was not independently read from the private route configuration. No event was submitted.

caller_route.hub_behavior: The Hub dispatches the configured shell action through executeMCPTool to its selected ShellMCP target. The documented fixed action runs python3 /home/roomhacker/gptadmin/scripts/agent_deliver.py with the JSON event as its sole argument.
caller_route.adapter_behavior: scripts/agent_deliver.py::main validates the event and maps it to Agent Herder deliver arguments.

protocol_boundary.transport: HTTP POST to http://127.0.0.1:18787/mcp from the server-100 shell adapter.

request.protocol: JSON-RPC 2.0 MCP tools/call over the Agent Herder Streamable HTTP endpoint's legacy stateless mode.
request.initialize_or_schema_discovery: omitted by the adapter; the caller relies on Agent Herder's legacy stateless HTTP compatibility path.

protocol_boundary.response: Accepts JSON or text/event-stream, unwraps structuredContent or JSON text content, rejects JSON-RPC/tool errors, and requires parsed result ok=true.
protocol_boundary.auth_boundary: The script sends no Authorization header. Agent Herder source allows unauthenticated owner-loopback MCP only on a managed fleet node when no HTTP token is configured; runtime token state was not inspected.
protocol_boundary.not_used: This caller does not invoke Agent Herder through GPTAdmin's generic child-MCP relay or a custom REST endpoint.

reproducible_check.scope: Local adapter validation and MCP error-to-failure handling; network calls are mocked, so this is not a live Agent Herder delivery proof.

scope_boundary: Records the existing Hub webhook-to-shell-to-MCP caller route and exact wire boundary. No GPTAdmin or Agent Herder runtime changes, route edits, new bridge, or additional state store are part of this target.
